findings.highlight: It’s only been half a day
findings.governingReading: Less than half a day has elapsed since Shirou embraced Sakura the previous night.
findings.explanation: The English rounds the upper bound into an elapsed half day.

findings.governingReading: Zouken contemptuously calls Shirou the Emiya brat or young whelp.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the belittling address to “boy.”

findings.highlight: he’s laughing with a hideous face
findings.evidenceJa: その面が醜悪に歪んでいる
findings.governingReading: Even unseen, Zouken’s face is plainly twisted into something hideous.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a hideous face used for laughing and removes the image of distortion.

findings.highlight: make her put her mind to it
findings.governingReading: Zouken says he cannot himself induce Sakura into the required state or willingness.
findings.explanation: The English uses an ill-fitting idiom suggesting deliberate concentration.

findings.highlight: I had to have you or Shinji break her down
findings.evidenceJa: アレの堰を壊してもらわねばならなかった
findings.governingReading: Zouken needed Shirou or Shinji to break the dam holding Sakura back.
findings.explanation: The English changes the breached restraint into psychologically breaking Sakura down.

findings.highlight: I needed Sakura to feel despair in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この世に絶望して貰わねばならなかった
findings.governingReading: Zouken needed Sakura to despair of the world itself.
findings.explanation: The English relocates despair within the world instead of making the world its object.

findings.governingReading: Zouken admits Sakura grew extraordinarily patient and capable of endurance.
findings.explanation: The English changes endurance under abuse into persistence, which can imply pursuit or stubbornness.

findings.governingReading: Shirou’s nerves or awareness contract into an intensely concentrated state.
findings.explanation: The English copies the Japanese metaphor into non-idiomatic English without conveying the bodily focus.

findings.highlight: I wanted you to betray her
findings.evidenceJa: おぬしの手で桜を裏切ってほしかった
findings.governingReading: Zouken specifically wanted Sakura betrayed by Shirou’s own hand.
findings.explanation: The English preserves betrayal but drops the instrumental emphasis on Shirou personally carrying it out.

findings.highlight: I unconsciously fill my hand with magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: ありったけの魔力を込めた一撃
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s single blow is packed with all the magical energy he has available.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the energy into his hand and removes the blow’s total expenditure.

findings.highlight: The worms I left to keep watch over this place have been crushed
findings.evidenceJa: 蟲どもが軒並み潰れおった
findings.governingReading: Zouken says the surveillance worms were crushed wholesale, one after another.
findings.explanation: The English reports destruction but omits its comprehensive extent.

findings.highlight: When did I do anything for you
findings.evidenceJa: 誰がおまえに尻尾を振った
findings.governingReading: Shirou denies ever wagging his tail for Zouken—that is, willingly serving or currying favor with him.
findings.explanation: The English broadens servile cooperation into having done anything that benefited Zouken.

findings.evidenceJa: 立ち止まる事などできん
findings.governingReading: Zouken says Sakura can no longer stop after killing her brother.
findings.explanation: The English changes inability to halt the ongoing process into inability to reverse course.

findings.governingReading: Once Archer’s soul and the gate key are taken, Zouken calls the position checkmate.
findings.explanation: The English removes the game metaphor and its claim that no moves remain.

findings.highlight: the reproduction of the Third Sorcery
findings.governingReading: The Makiri ambition is the reproduction of the Third Magic.
findings.explanation: The English uses “Third Sorcery,” destabilizing a central fixed Fate term.

findings.governingReading: Zouken’s loud laughter is grating on the ear.
findings.explanation: The English weakens an abrasive audible quality into the narrator finding it annoying.
